summary: The marketing team is deep in execution mode, prioritizing the China Going-Global report for a September launch while advancing SEO and website improvements, but must resolve internal operational snags like the Outlook lockout and social media agency selection this week.
summaryDetail: The flagship initiative is the joint CKGSB-IE report 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global,' targeting a September launch in Singapore. The team is finalizing the structure, with a one-pager proposal due from Felix, leadership op-ed confirmations from Julian, and content compilation reviews by Joseph and Tian this week. Launch event coordination with Tech in Asia and Tyson is underway, with a confirmation email due to Miguel on July 28. Concurrently, SEO efforts are prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with target audience profiling and conversion tracking validation in progress. The knowledge website redesign is moving forward, with feedback due from Joseph and Julie, and integration of indices into the homepage. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook account lockout to restore team communication, expedite the social media agency selection (considering Media Minds), and complete the AI-generated meta-description review by July 31. Upcoming: website chatbot testing by July 30 and the EuroCham event collaboration proceeding.
